source: Lantern Scout availability collector v3.2 (public no-auth APIs; Verda and Lambda via authenticated vendor APIs, labelled per row)

rows.tier: Marketplace on-demand (host USD listings; median per GPU)
rows.availability_note: unrented servers (one server may hold several GPUs), any currency
rows.available_regions_label: seen in stock at check time; available_regions lists only regions confirmed in stock by two reads; available_regions_detail also lists single-read and unconfirmed regions (see confirmation/confirmed)

rows.availability_note: tier 'On-demand' is INFERRED by Scout (the CloudRift API has no tier label); the feed join attaches this claim only if cost_per_hour/100 equals the feed price and VRAM is 80 GB. available_gpus = CloudRift nodes with a free 1-GPU slot per data center (available_nodes_per_dc of the 1-GPU variant); nodes, not GPUs

tier 'On-demand' for non-spot models is INFERRED by Scout (the stock API has no tier label; '-spot' models map to 'Spot VM'); the feed join attaches the claim only if the live pricebook price (GET /v1/pricebook, same exact model name) equals the feed price and VRAM matches. Hyperstack stock API 'available' per region (string, e.g. '10+' read as >= 10); model matched by exact API name incl. VRAM; Reservation prices have no stock signal and stay unknown
